name: Tanados UI
description: Tanados UI rebrands Jellyfin Web automatically with the Tanados logo/colors and adds the enhanced MonWUI/JMSFusion experience layer.
overview: Tanados-branded Jellyfin Web UI upgrade with automatic logo replacement, purple/gold theme accents, cinematic sliders, enhanced details, playback, profiles, watchlist, and settings.

versions.changelog:
v2.9.0.2

Hotfixes:
- Fixed the Tanados settings shell so long sections scroll correctly again, with a larger modal layout that behaves better on desktop, mobile, and TV-class browsers
- Added admin branding asset upload support for header logo, login logo, favicon, and login background without hand-editing plugin files
- Added browser smoke coverage for recent movie row injection alongside the existing login/settings/upcoming checks

Notes:
- Restart Jellyfin after installing or updating
- Refresh Jellyfin Web after updating so the new runtime assets are loaded
